name: Iori
message: 「Morning, everyone.」
As I entered the classroom as usual, the faces waiting for me greeted me quietly. They certainly look different today than they usually do.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, all five of you are here.」
Setsugekka and Ririmu are looking at me with tense expressions. By contrast, Momiji, Keisetsu, and Asahi seem much more relaxed.

name: Iori
message: 「Well then... the midterm exams finally start today！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughhh, it’s finally here！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Lord, have mercy, Lord, have mercy.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Praying now isn't going to help, you know.」

name: Iori
message: 「The exam schedule is for four days total, from today the 19th through the 22nd.」

name: Iori
message: 「The first day is a written exam, the second day is a martial demonstration, and the third and fourth days are practical exams.」

name: Iori
message: 「As I’ve said many times, this is an important exam that also serves to select members for the Martial Festival preliminaries.」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone, be prepared to give it your all！」
For the first day’s written exam, the questions are displayed via hologram, and you fill in your answers accordingly.
Once the start time hits, they are automatically displayed on our desks.

name: Iori
message: 「...Still a little time before it begins. Might as well have a little chat.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, how about you? Are you confident?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes! I have absolutely no basis for it, but I have total confidence that I’ll be fine!」

name: Iori
message: 「U-uh, I see. Well, having some is better than having none. How about you, Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m golden.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, I’m a scholarship student, so if I just clear this exam, I shouldn't really have to attend classes or anything anyway.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Thinking about that just kind of ticks me off.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, Momiji, you’re acting like a tsundere as usual.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even the teacher is saying it！? And besides, you’re using that word wrong！」

name: Iori
message: 「Next up is Asahi. Do you seem okay?」
I ignored Momiji, who was still squawking, and turned to Asahi.

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I’m all set. My information gathering was perfect.」

name: Iori
message: 「...You didn't hack into the system to get the exam content beforehand, did you？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, I didn't. I really didn't.」
Ah, I'm nervous....

name: Iori
message: 「Next is Ririmu, but...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Namu-san, namu-san, namu-san...」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait！ Don't talk to me right now！ I'll forget all the exam material I just memorized！」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, uh... do your best. Keisetsu, well, I guess she’s fine.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Excuse me, why am I an afterthought？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, it's just that I don't think Momiji or Keisetsu would fail no matter what happens.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You don't know that. I haven't done any exam preparation at all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that so？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, I've been busy with work communications lately. I haven't had time for that.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Well, regardless, I intend to produce results worthy of the next head of the Kazamine family. You can rest assured on that front.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I'm counting on you.」
Five people, five different ways, each facing the exam with their own intentions in mind.

name: Iori
message: 「It'll be alright. If it's you all, I'm sure you can successfully get through these midterms.」

name: Iori
message: 「You've done enough work alongside me. Believe in yourselves and face it head-on.」
Fighting spirit wells up in everyone's eyes.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright... it's beginning. Everyone, do your best！！」

name: Academy System
message: 「――We will now begin the written test for the first subject of the midterm exam.」
Holographic displays appeared in front of the five of them, and the midterm exams finally began.
Four days starting from today. Everyone, not a single person missing.
I hope they can make it through safely—！

name: Iori
message: 「...Good morning, everyone.」
I walked into the classroom as usual and looked out over the room.
The midterms finished all their stages yesterday—and the grading results are out.
Today is the day I tell everyone the results.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……U-um, sensei.」
Everyone wears the same solemn expression.

name: Iori
message: 「What is it？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-you have a scary look on your face, but…… were you okay？ Could it be that…… er……」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m about to announce that now.」
With an expressionless face, I look over the five students one by one.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah— stop, that makes me so nervous！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「How about we just go with a light vibe like, ‘Yup, you’re all good!’? Let’s do that, okay, please!?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, no way…… we aren’t going for that vibe…？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ririmu, I’ll be sure to collect your remains.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey— stop, seriously, that’s not funny! Come on, Sensei, just hurry up and <d0101>finish me off</d> already!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aaaaaaah, if I fail here, Kei-chan’s 24-hour endurance lecture is gonna start！！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I wouldn’t do such a thing, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「R-really？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I don’t have the time to waste on someone who would fail a midterm.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah…… that’s even worse……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Waaaaaah, it’s over, it’s all over, Kei-chan’s gonna abandon me~！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, the classroom is getting loud, so could you please tell us the results now？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, right.」

name: Iori
message: 「……Then, I will announce the results of the midterm exam！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「G-gulp……！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Anything but failure, anything but that……！」
Holding their breath, everyone waits for my words.

name: Iori
message: 「……Everyone passed！！ There’s not a single failure among you！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「W-we did itttttttt！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Secchan, we did it! We actually got through the midterms!!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, we sure did, Secchan！！」
Setsugekka and Ririmu jump up while hugging each other. The two of them really worked hard, after all.

name: Asahi
message: 「Congratulations, I'm glad for you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Phew, we somehow managed to pull it off, huh.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, thank you so much, everyone! Yay, hooray!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I don't know how many times I thought about giving up halfway through... Ahh, I'm just so happy！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm so glad I stuck with it to the end! I'm seriously grateful to Iorin and everyone!」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's because you worked hard, Ririmu. I'm truly happy for you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, you avoided failing, but I would have liked to see a bit higher scores.」
Setsugekka is slightly above the grade average, and Ririmu is below it. These aren't scores one can exactly celebrate with open arms.

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, no, no need to worry about the numbers! Once you pass, you're home free!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn't it a bit too early to be celebrating？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Indeed, the important part is just beginning.」

name: Asahi
message: 「The selection for the Martial Festival preliminary rounds, that is.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「O-oh, that's right...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahh, I wasn't in a position to be saying I didn't need to worry about my scores after all!」
Setsugekka and Ririmu both clutch their heads again.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei, what about the recommendations？ Did you recommend us！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course. I've already submitted recommendations for all four members of the Takamura Class Martial Arts Division.」

name: Iori
message: 「From here on, it depends on the selection committee's decision based on the results of these midterms.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Please, please let me make the list of members for the preliminaries...！」
Momiji, who had a relaxed expression just a moment ago, is now listening with a serious look on her face.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, I will announce the selected members for the Martial Festival preliminary matches！」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ll read them out in order of selection. First off—」

name: Iori
message: 「Suzakuin Momiji！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Phew, good grief.」

name: Iori
message: 「In the midterms―written, performance, and practical exams―you were top of the grade in everything. You’re in the preliminary squad, no arguments here！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa… top of the grade, huh. As expected of a Suzakuin.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, obviously.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Tch, look at that smug face. So annoying!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah, don’t be jealous.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei, who’s next？ It’s me next, right！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Right, next up. For Takamura Class, the second selection is… Kuki Asahi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehhh！？」

name: Iori
message: 「You were in the top twenty for the written exam, and your performance and practicals were solid. I think it’s fair to say you’re in the preliminaries with room to spare.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, so frustrating… but, I guess that makes sense. Asahi-chan is smart and she’s good at the performances too, after all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, you flatter me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even though she’s got a super crappy personality, but that doesn’t have anything to do with the exams, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san, isn't that a bit unnecessary？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「More importantly, it’s gotta be me next, right? Me, me!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait a sec, Ririmu-chan, does that mean I’m dead last！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh, I’m not gonna lose to you in the practicals, Secchan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why you…! I’m higher than you when it comes to the written exams!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Watching the peons squabble is quite amusing.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn’t it though?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Th-these girls… they’re acting so smug!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Teacher, please tell us the next part quickly!」

name: Iori
message: 「……Since when did you get the misconception that there would be a next part？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, you’re joking, right…… No way……」

name: Asahi
message: 「Are you saying that only two members from the Takamura Class were selected？」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Well, it’s not exactly an impossible scenario.」

name: Momiji
message: 「There are about 100 first-years in the Martial Arts Division, and less than 30 of them get chosen for the preliminary team.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「N-no way……」

name: Iori
message: 「……I’m just kidding.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, Ririmu, you’re both officially on the preliminary team！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, eh！？ Then…… that was a prank just now！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heyyyyy, Teacher, don’t do stuff like that！ Seriously, I thought my heart was going to stop！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, sorry, sorry. You were being a bit too noisy, so I wanted to get you to quiet down.」

name: Iori
message: 「As for the Takamura Class, all four of the members I recommended were safely selected for the preliminary team.」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone, congratulations！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaay！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Glad to hear it~」

name: Asahi
message: 「Congratulations.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka and Ririmu, your written tests and form demonstrations were average, but your perfect win record in the practical exam was highly valued.」

name: Iori
message: 「It seems some members of the selection committee were concerned about the Takamura Class’s bad reputation, but your talent and potential received universal acclaim.」

name: Iori
message: 「In the end, the selection committee reached a unanimous decision to select all four Takamura Class members for the preliminary team, I’m told.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ohhh！ How about that, did you see that！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, that’s crazy! That means we were getting tons of praise from the selection committee, right!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, a natural result, isn't it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Asahi, did you actually pull some strings or something？」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, I did not. I didn't see any need to.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey hey, Asahi, come on, put your hand out！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Eh... Yes, like this？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yay, we did it~!♪」
Asahi and Ririmu high-five each other in delight.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Now we can enter the Martial Festival together!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, let's do our best so we can advance to the main tournament.」
The two were quite hostile toward each other at one point, but now they are getting along remarkably well. It's heartwarming to see.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey Kei-chan, we did it! We've made it through the qualifiers!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I'm glad for you. But the real challenge begins now.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, I know. I’ll definitely make it to the main tournament. And I’ll become the Toujinegi, for sure！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, I'm counting on you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Leave it to me！ I'll definitely beat Momimomi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I feel the same. I won't lose to Momiji-san.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Me too, of course！ I’m super strong right now, y'know♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why do you all keep dragging me into this?」
Momiji looks fed up.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, now that everyone has safely made it through the qualifiers, why don't we go somewhere and have a little celebration?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, I wanna, I wanna！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sounds good~! Nice idea, Sensei!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Where shall we celebrate?」

name: Momiji
message: 「It's gotta be <d0102>Yakiniku</d>, obviously. On Sensei's tab.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-w-wait a second！ Buying Yakiniku for five people is a bit much...！」
Everyone's eyes sparkle with excitement.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yakiniku！ Yakiniku！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yakiniku~, yakiniku~！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yakiniku♪ Yakiniku♪」

name: Asahi
message: 「I want to eat yakiniku!」
Everyone started clapping along.

name: Iori
message: 「H-hey, you guys...！」
They sure know how to stick together when it counts...！

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, fine, I get it！ It’s my treat today！ Eat as much meat as you want！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yakiniku tastes better when it’s someone else’s money.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, I’ll take you up on that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yippee~~~~！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I wonder if I may join in as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course, Keisetsu is a student of the Takamura Class, after all.」
As I said that, I screamed in my heart.
Seriously, you guys... you’re definitely richer than a humble civil servant like me, right...？
